   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 12, 2026 - Jul 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JadedMind_, Jul 23, 2026, 2/5: "I can no longer log into this app on my phone, which makes it useless. No matter what I click, including contacting support, I get a message saying it can’t connect to the server. I don’t have this issue with any other app on my phone."
            2. _guymanstuff_, Jul 9, 2026, 3/5: "Can you please list in the release notes what you are actually fixing instead of just “we are making the app awesome for you” or “bye bye bugs”?"
            3. _rasnauf_, Jun 15, 2026, 4/5: "Good app, but it has some issues: - Sometimes it's very slow, with 5+ second latency between interaction and UI update. The only reliable fix seems to be to delete the app and reinstall—closing and reopening doesn't work. - Due date reminders are lagging: they send a notification to your phone ~45 seconds after the reminder you set. - When viewing a Board, sometimes each List will have multiple copies of itself underneath the "original" list."
